note: Service: the People's Military Service Law (2010), enacted by the previous regime and enforced from the military government's announcement of 10 February 2024, per DVB's explainer: men aged eighteen to thirty-five and women aged eighteen to twenty-seven must serve up to two years; specialists such as doctors up to forty-five serve three years (not held). Held as two terms, men eighteen to thirty-five and women eighteen to twenty-seven. The law's own text wasn't read: the Myanmar Law Information System (mlis.gov.mm) reset the connection on 2026-10-31. Two years is the term the explainer gives as the maximum ('up to two years'), held as twenty-four months. Majority: held as eighteen from the Child Rights Law (2019), which defines a child as anyone under eighteen, per UNICEF's statement on its enactment (24 July 2019): a reading, since the Majority Act (1875) itself wasn't read. Work: null. UNICEF's statement says the Child Rights Law sets fourteen as the minimum age of employment, but nothing read says what the law allows a performer under fourteen, so the form's work isn't filled; the Ministry of Labour (mol.gov.mm) and the Myanmar Law Information System (mlis.gov.mm) reset the connection, and the law's text wasn't found elsewhere.

sources.title: UNICEF Myanmar: The enactment of the new Child Rights Law by the Government of Myanmar a landmark step (press release, 24 July 2019)
sources.said: Under the newly enacted Child Rights Law, a child is defined as anyone under the age of 18. ... With the establishment of a minimum age of marriage (18 years) and to employment (14 years)

sources.title: DVB (Democratic Voice of Burma): Myanmar's military conscription law explained
sources.said: Mandatory military service was declared on Feb. 10 under the People’s Military Service Law. It was enacted in 2010 under a previous regime but had yet to be enforced up until now. The law requires men aged 18 to 35 and women aged 18 to 27 to serve up to two years, while specialists like doctors aged up to 45 must serve for three years.
